concept.object: a round glossy toy sun with a warm smiling glow
concept.morph: the sun squashes into an upright rounded rectangle and a single horizontal bar snaps across its middle
concept.hook: 太陽會像果凍一樣被壓扁，中間啪一聲多一橫

promptVersions.conceptZh: 豬探長舉著超大放大鏡辦案，鏡片把他的眼睛放大成爆笑巨眼；他湊得太近撞到太陽，太陽被壓成直立的圓角方塊，脫手的放大鏡橫飛過來「喀」一聲卡進中間變成那一橫，合成「日」。
promptVersions.object: a chubby glossy toy sun ball with a calm smiling face, and a stout cartoon detective pig with an oversized magnifying glass
promptVersions.morph: the sun squashes into an upright rounded rectangle while the flying magnifying glass snaps across its middle and smooths into the single horizontal stroke of 日
promptVersions.creativeAngle: 第一次為「日」補上 prompt。用孩子喜歡的豬探長開場，放大鏡巨眼是笑點，也自然帶出「撞一下→壓扁→橫桿插進來」的因果，不靠老套的果凍登場。語音詞選「生日」，日固定念ㄖˋ、生固定念ㄕㄥ，沒有破音風險。
promptVersions.promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second 3D stylized toy animation as one continuous locked-off shot on a clean solid light-cream background. Centered stands a chubby glossy toy sun: a round tangerine ball with a calm smiling face. A stout cartoon detective pig in a checked deerstalker hat and a tiny trench coat waddles in from the left, holding a magnifying glass far too big for him. From 0.6 to 2.2 seconds he leans in to inspect the sun and, seen through the lens, his one eye balloons to a comically enormous size and blinks twice while the rest of him stays small. Hold that silly pose for a beat. At 2.6 seconds he leans one step too close, bonks the sun with the lens rim, and the sun squashes with a soft jelly wobble into an upright rounded rectangle of saturated vermilion. The magnifying glass pops out of his hands, spins once through the air, and snaps horizontally across the middle of that rectangle with a satisfying click, its rim and handle smoothing into one clean straight stroke. The detective pig tips his hat, very pleased with himself, and hops out of frame to the left by 4.6 seconds. By 5.0 seconds the shape has resolved into one correctly formed Traditional Chinese character 日 in saturated vermilion, perfectly centered and uncropped, filling about 70% of the frame height with generous margins on all sides, its outer box and single middle bar crisp, straight and clearly separated. From 5.0 to 8.0 seconds the frame holds completely still on 日 with nothing else moving in the shot. Style: Pixar-like glossy chunky toy materials, soft studio lighting, bright high-contrast but not neon colors, no dark or moody grading. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin and says exactly 「日、日、生日」, using the reading ㄖˋ for 日 both times and in the word. Speak the first 日 around 0.5 seconds, the second around 2.0 seconds, and 生日 around 5.6 seconds during the still hold, with natural pauses, then stop; do not keep chanting the character or repeat the line. Keep the bonk and the click soft and clear of the voice, and use no music louder than the voice. The spoken word is audio only and must not appear as imagery. The only writing anywhere in the frame is the single character 日: no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no other letters, numbers, watermarks, scenery, extra props, particles, lens flare, motion blur on the glyph, or flashing effects.

promptVersions.morph: the crescent tips upright into the two outer strokes while two chunky bricks from the hero’s belt glide in from the left and click into the two short horizontal strokes of 月

promptVersions.promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second 3D stylized toy animation as one continuous locked-off shot on a clean solid pale-lilac background. Centered lies a chunky cream-colored crescent moon toy resting on its back like a little hammock. From 0.4 seconds a small boxy toy robot hero with pointed ears, round friendly eyes and a short red cape struts in, climbs onto the crescent, and strikes an extremely dramatic pose with his cape flaring, trying to hang upside down from the tip. At 2.0 seconds his weight tips the crescent: it swings upright with a slow comic creak until it stands tall as the two outer strokes, and the tiny hero slides all the way down the inside of the curve and lands on his backside with a soft bonk, his cape flopping over his head. He peeks out from under the cape for a beat. At 3.2 seconds two chunky interlocking plastic bricks pop off his utility belt and glide in from the left, clicking into place one above the other inside the crescent to become the two short horizontal strokes. The hero gives a tiny satisfied thumbs-up and hops out of frame to the right by 4.7 seconds. By 5.0 seconds everything has resolved into one correctly formed Traditional Chinese character 月 in saturated deep indigo, perfectly centered and uncropped, filling about 70% of the frame height with generous margins on all sides, its long left stroke, hooked right stroke and two inner bars crisp and clearly separated. From 5.0 to 8.0 seconds the frame holds completely still on 月 with nothing else moving in the shot. Style: Pixar-like glossy chunky toy materials, soft studio lighting, bright high-contrast but not neon colors, no dark or moody night grading. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin and says exactly 「月、月、月亮」, using the reading ㄩㄝˋ for 月 both times and in the word. Speak the first 月 around 0.5 seconds, the second around 2.0 seconds, and 月亮 around 5.6 seconds during the still hold, with natural pauses, then stop; do not keep chanting the character or repeat the line. Keep the creak, bonk and brick clicks soft and clear of the voice, and use no music louder than the voice. The spoken word is audio only and must not appear as imagery. The only writing anywhere in the frame is the single character 月: no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no other letters, numbers, watermarks, scenery, extra props, particles, lens flare, motion blur on the glyph, or flashing effects.

concept.morph: the three peaks straighten into three vertical strokes standing on one horizontal base
concept.hook: 三座山站直變成三根柱子

promptVersions.conceptZh: 矮胖的戰鬥機器人用積木蓋山：左右兩根疊得剛剛好，他站上中間那根想再加一塊，結果中間柱子一直往上長，把他舉得超高，他在頂端手忙腳亂地揮手，最後滑桿溜下來；一條長積木從底下滑進來把三根接起來，變成「山」。
promptVersions.object: a stubby armored toy battle robot and stacks of chunky interlocking plastic bricks
promptVersions.morph: three brick columns rise with the middle one tallest and a long flat brick slides in beneath them, joining their feet into the base stroke of 山
promptVersions.creativeAngle: 第一次為「山」補上 prompt。用孩子喜歡的戰鬥機器人加樂高積木，笑點是「柱子自己一直長高，把蓋房子的人舉到天上」的尺寸落差，而這個動作本身就是中間那一豎變長的筆劃邏輯。語音詞選「火山」，火ㄏㄨㄛˇ、山ㄕㄢ都是單一讀音，且火是他已經學過的字。
promptVersions.promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second 3D stylized toy animation as one continuous locked-off shot on a clean solid light-cream background. A stubby, friendly toy battle robot with rounded armored shoulders and stompy feet is busy building with chunky interlocking plastic bricks, centered in frame. From 0.3 to 1.6 seconds he snaps together a short column of deep teal bricks on the left and a matching short column on the right, dusts off his hands, and nods with satisfaction. At 1.8 seconds he climbs onto the low middle stack to add one more brick on top, but the middle column keeps growing under his feet, brick after brick, lifting him far too high above his own building; he wobbles at the top, pedals his little arms in comic surprise, and freezes wide-eyed for a beat. At 3.2 seconds he gives up, hugs the column and slides all the way down it like a fire pole, landing with a soft thump and a puff of pride. At 3.8 seconds one long flat brick glides in from below and clicks across the feet of all three columns, joining them into a single base. The robot stomps out of frame to the left by 4.7 seconds. By 5.0 seconds the build has resolved into one correctly formed Traditional Chinese character 山 in saturated deep teal, perfectly centered and uncropped, filling about 70% of the frame height with generous margins on all sides: one tall centre stroke, a shorter stroke on each side, and one clean horizontal base, all crisp and clearly separated. From 5.0 to 8.0 seconds the frame holds completely still on 山 with nothing else moving in the shot. Style: Pixar-like glossy chunky toy materials, soft studio lighting, bright high-contrast but not neon colors, no dark or moody grading. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin and says exactly 「山、山、火山」, using the reading ㄕㄢ for 山 both times and in the word. Speak the first 山 around 0.5 seconds, the second around 2.0 seconds, and 火山 around 5.6 seconds during the still hold, with natural pauses, then stop; do not keep chanting the character or repeat the line. Keep the brick clicks and the thump soft and clear of the voice, and use no music louder than the voice. The spoken word is audio only: add no volcano, lava, smoke or fire imagery of any kind. The only writing anywhere in the frame is the single character 山: no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no other letters, numbers, watermarks, scenery, extra props, particles, lens flare, motion blur on the glyph, or flashing effects.

concept.morph: the splash arms fling outward into the left and right strokes while the core stretches into the central hook
concept.hook: 水滴啪一下炸開，變成字

promptVersions.conceptZh: 「水」字化成四筆清楚的藍色小水道，紙船順著中央豎鉤漂流，在鉤尾輕輕轉彎。
promptVersions.object: A cobalt-blue watercourse shaped precisely like 水, with one tiny yellow paper boat.
promptVersions.morph: Begin with the complete glyph. Water moves inside its four fixed stroke silhouettes; the central vertical hook carries a tiny boat, while the three surrounding strokes remain separate, clearly defined channels. Surface details gradually disappear into a solid blue glyph.
promptVersions.creativeAngle: 從完整字形出發，把中央豎鉤變成紙船的轉彎水道；用小船轉向的驚喜凸顯鉤筆，避免水花變字造成筆畫模糊。
promptVersions.promptEn:
Create an exactly 8-second animation teaching the Traditional Chinese character 水 to a Taiwanese child aged 6–8. Use a locked, straight-on overhead view against a warm, pale cream background. From the first frame, show one correctly formed 水, centered and uncropped, approximately 70% of frame height with generous margins. Base its exact four-stroke silhouette on a standard Traditional Chinese educational typeface. Render those strokes as saturated cobalt-blue enamel water channels with shallow water inside; preserve every stroke boundary and the open spaces between strokes throughout.

At 0.6 seconds, a tiny yellow paper boat appears within the top of the central vertical stroke. It drifts downward, making the meaning of water tangible. Restrained ripples travel separately along the left bent stroke, upper-right short falling stroke, and lower-right sweeping stroke, without connecting their channels or extending beyond their silhouettes. At 2.8 seconds, the boat reaches the central hook: the current gently turns its pointed bow along the hook, giving it a charming little change of direction. Keep the boat small enough that the blue stroke remains clearly readable around it. By 4.2 seconds, dissolve the boat and internal ripples while smoothly flattening the enamel shading. From 4.2 through 8.0 seconds, hold the resulting solid cobalt-blue 水 completely still and unobstructed for 3.8 full seconds.

A warm adult voice clearly pronounces 水 four times in Taiwanese Mandarin, shuǐ, ㄕㄨㄟˇ, with a natural isolated third tone, beginning at 0.2, 2.1, 4.6, and 6.6 seconds. Use soft water sounds beneath the action, quiet during speech and silent during the final hold. The watercourse is a playful visual metaphor, not an explanation of historical etymology. Keep the composition bright but not neon, with no camera movement, flashing effects, additional writing, subtitles, logos, watermarks, or background props.

promptVersions.object: A miniature bamboo spring spout dispensing clear aqua water onto a pale cream porcelain surface.
promptVersions.morph: The main stream flows downward to carve the central hooked vertical stroke, while branching streamlets fill the left angled stroke and right falling/sweeping strokes of the glyph.
promptVersions.creativeAngle: 區隔於前一版的紙船漂流設計，改採用竹管泉水自然湧流與動態分流的實體物理隱喻。藉由中央主水流與兩側分支水流精準勾勒出「水」字的四個筆畫，並在流動完成後迅速凝固為飽和的鈷藍色字體，達成筆順清晰度與長達3.2秒的穩定定格。
promptVersions.promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second animation teaching the Traditional Chinese character 水 to a Taiwanese child aged 6–8. Use a locked, straight-on overhead camera angle against a warm, pale cream porcelain background. Centered in the frame, a smooth miniature bamboo spout positioned at the top center releases a sparkling stream of translucent aqua-blue spring water. At 0.4 seconds, the main water stream glides vertically downward, curving gently at the bottom to form the central hooked vertical stroke (豎鉤). At 1.8 seconds, two smaller trickles branch out from the main stream: one glides to the left to form the angled stroke (橫撇), while the other flows right, splitting into the upper-right falling stroke (撇) and lower-right sweeping stroke (捺). The water streams fill the precise four-stroke silhouette of a standard Traditional Chinese educational typeface for 水, maintaining distinct stroke boundaries without spilling over. At 3.6 seconds, the bamboo spout smoothly retracts upward out of frame while the flowing water inside the four strokes instantly settles into a solid, vibrant cobalt-blue enamel glyph. From 4.8 seconds to 8.0 seconds, hold the completed, solid blue 水 character completely still and unobstructed for a full 3.2-second final hold, occupying approximately 70% of the frame height with clean margins. A warm adult voice clearly pronounces 水 four times in Taiwanese Mandarin, shuǐ, ㄕㄨㄟˇ, with a natural isolated third tone, at 0.2, 2.0, 4.6, and 6.6 seconds. Soft, relaxing water trickling sounds accompany the liquid animation, turning silent during the final hold. Keep the lighting bright and warm, with zero camera motion, flashing effects, subtitles, extra text, logos, or watermarks.

【設計概念】：關節木手伸展動作：斜伸的大拇指化為首筆撇畫，張開的手指平伸分組形成長短兩道橫畫，手腕順勢向下延伸並向左勾起成為豎鉤，直觀對應「手」字的四筆結構。
【8s Video Prompt】:
```text
An 8-second 3D educational animation designed for Taiwanese children aged 6-8, teaching the Traditional Chinese character '手' (hand). Against a soft warm cream background, a bright jointed wooden toy hand catches a bouncing ball and presses flat against the surface (0:00-0:02). As it settles, the hand fluidly morphs into strokes: the angled thumb slides up-left into the top diagonal stroke (撇), the outstretched fingers align into two clean horizontal bars—a shorter upper bar and a longer lower bar—and the wrist pulls down through the center, smoothly hooking to the left at the bottom to form the vertical hook stroke (豎鉤) (0:02-0:05). The object resolves perfectly into the solid, saturated coral-red Traditional Chinese glyph '手'. The character sits precisely centered, filling 70% of the frame height with generous margins, holding still for a complete 3-second hold (0:05-0:08). Clear Taiwanese Mandarin child voiceover pronounces 'ㄕㄡˇ, 手!' at 0:02, 'ㄕㄡˇ, 手!' at 0:04, and '手!' during the hold. Bright, high-contrast lighting with gentle soft shadows, crisp readability, no watermarks, text overlays, or flashing effects.
```

promptVersions.morph: The oversized toy hand detaches and unfolds cleanly: the angled thumb slides up-left into the top diagonal stroke, the fingers form two horizontal bars (shorter top, longer bottom), and the wrist pulls straight down through the center into a sharp left hook.

promptVersions.promptEn: An 8-second 3D educational animation centered on the Traditional Chinese character '手'. Against a soft, warm pastel teal background, a cute tiny blocky toy robot wearing an absurdly oversized wooden toy hand tries to wave enthusiastically (0:00-0:02). The top-heavy hand tips the little robot forward onto its belly with a harmless, funny wobble. In a comic surprise, the robot pops back onto its feet as the oversized toy hand detaches and fluidly transforms into glyph strokes (0:02-0:05): the angled thumb sweeps up to the left into the top diagonal stroke (撇), the blocky fingers line up into two horizontal parallel bars—a shorter top bar and a longer lower bar—and the wooden wrist extends straight down through the center, hooking sharply to the left at the base to form the vertical hook stroke (豎鉤). The strokes instantly fuse into the clean, vibrant coral-orange Traditional Chinese glyph '手', perfectly centered and occupying 70% of the frame height with generous margins (0:05-0:08). The glyph remains completely static for a solid 3-second hold. Warm, clear off-screen Taiwanese Mandarin voiceover pronounces '手' at 0:01, '手' at 0:03, and the everyday word '手套' cleanly at 0:05 during the static hold. High-contrast studio lighting with soft shadows; no on-screen text overlays, subtitles, or watermarks.

promptVersions.object: A solid blue toy glyph, a friendly mechanical eyeball, and a tiny magnifying glass with toy feet.
promptVersions.morph: The glyph remains structurally unchanged while a mechanical eye peers through its middle opening; a magnifying glass briefly enlarges the pupil before both props withdraw.
promptVersions.creativeAngle: 讓正確字形從頭保留，以放大鏡意外放大眼睛的尺寸反差製造笑點，避免眼睛變形時造成筆畫混淆。
promptVersions.promptEn:
Create an exactly 8-second animated toy vignette with a locked frontal camera, warm cream background, soft lighting, and bright, non-neon colors. Center one correctly formed Traditional Chinese glyph「目」in saturated solid cobalt blue, approximately 70% of frame height, fully uncropped with generous margins. Make it a shallow wooden toy frame: a tall closed rectangular outline with exactly two evenly spaced interior horizontal strokes joining both sides, creating three clear rectangular openings. Keep every stroke stationary and readable throughout.

At the opening, a tiny brass magnifying glass with mechanical toy feet tiptoes toward the middle opening. A friendly mechanical eyeball on a short telescoping stalk waits behind that opening, its rounded ivory housing and blue iris visibly toy-like. By 1.5 seconds, the little magnifier leans forward to inspect it. Pause briefly in anticipation. At 2.2 seconds, the eye leans toward the lens: its pupil suddenly appears comically enormous inside the tiny magnifying glass! The magnifier does one small, silent backward hop on its spring feet; the eye answers with a slow, sheepish blink. Keep this optical gag inside the opening, without covering the blue strokes. The magnifier walks behind the frame and the eye retracts backward, both completely concealed by 4.5 seconds. From 4.5 through 8 seconds, hold the finished glyph perfectly still and unobstructed against the plain cream background.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin, saying exactly「目、目、目光」, with 目 pronounced mù. Place the first utterance around 0.5 seconds, the second around 2.0 seconds, and the word around 5.3 seconds during the clear final hold. Use natural pauses and stop after the word. Only the single target glyph appears on screen; the vocabulary remains audio only. No subtitles, other text, watermark, clutter, flashing effects, or background music.

promptVersions.creativeAngle: 結合家長建議「超級大的大巨人」，以合規的機械玩具機器人為主角。運用玩具抽搐充氣彈飛小球的喜劇肢體（Visual Gag），連結「大」字的空間張力與筆畫結構（一橫與雙撇腳），並提供超過3秒的安定靜態呈現。

The sudden puff pops a small wooden block off its head into the air, causing the robot to blink its round marble eyes in funny surprise. At 2-4.5 seconds, the robot's silhouette smoothly fuses and simplifies into the saturated solid-colored Traditional Chinese character '大', where the straight shoulder bar forms the upper horizontal stroke (一) and the long body and legs form the sweeping left diagonal (丿) and right diagonal (乀). Audio features a friendly off-screen voice speaking clear Taiwanese Mandarin: '大、大、大象'. Clean lighting with crisp contrast; no subtitles, watermarks, or extra on-screen text.

promptVersions.promptEn:
Create an exactly 8-second stylized 3D toy animation with a warm cream background, bright non-neon colors, soft lighting, and a locked frontal view. One correctly formed Traditional Chinese glyph 刀 appears centered from the opening, in saturated solid blue, with its two standard strokes clearly separated: a horizontal turning into a descending hook, and a distinct left-falling stroke. Beneath it, stage a small foam cake and an obviously mechanical chibi Iron Man robot toy with red-and-gold plastic armor, visible hinge joints, and mitten-shaped grippers. No logos or written character names. The robot holds a chunky plastic toy knife with a broad rounded tip and a visibly blunt edge.
During 0.0–1.4 seconds, the robot solemnly braces both feet and raises the little knife over the foam cake, pausing with exaggerated determination. During 1.4–2.8 seconds, it presses the knife through a precut seam; the foam halves squash outward, then spring neatly back together as soon as the knife lifts, leaving the cake looking untouched. During 2.8–3.6 seconds, the robot freezes, tilts its helmet toward the knife, then toward the perfectly restored cake: one clear, gentle comic double take. Use only a soft foam squeak for the rebound. During 3.6–4.5 seconds, the entire small toy stage lowers out of frame while the glyph smoothly enlarges without changing its stroke shapes or proportions. From 4.5–8.0 seconds, hold only the finished 刀 absolutely still, centered, unobstructed and uncropped, filling about 70% of frame height with generous margins. Keep the teaching glyph centered and fully readable throughout.
Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin. The ONLY spoken line is exactly "刀、刀、小刀". Say the first 刀 around 0.5 seconds, the second 刀 around 1.7 seconds, and 小刀 naturally during 5.0–6.2 seconds, with clear pauses and no rushed delivery. Pronunciation lock: 刀 = ㄉㄠ, dāo; 小刀 = xiǎo dāo. Bopomofo and pinyin are silent pronunciation directions, never spoken or displayed. Both isolated readings and the 刀 syllable in 小刀 use the identical dāo reading. Stop speaking after 小刀. The vocabulary is audio only. The single glyph 刀 is the only on-screen text; no subtitles, additional glyphs, watermarks, clutter, or flashing effects. No music; keep the soft toy sound below the voice.

Silent pronunciation directions, never spoken or displayed: 米 = ㄇㄧˇ = mǐ; 米飯 = mǐ fàn. Use the same mǐ reading for all three occurrences. Stop after 米飯. No other dialogue or music. Theme: Pig Detective 豬探長 as a cartoon pig in a detective hat investigates a rice bowl; one sticky rice grain on his snout is the silly clue. Use clearly stylized toys or cartoon animals; costume characters must be obviously toy/robot figures. Keep the character itself and its meaning central; the prop gag is brief and the final glyph remains correct, unobstructed, large and still for at least 3 seconds. No logos or written character names on screen.
PRONUNCIATION LOCK: target 米, Bopomofo ㄇㄧˇ, Mandarin pinyin mǐ. The ONLY spoken line must be exactly "米、米、米飯". Example word is fixed as 米飯, pronounced mǐ fàn. Do not substitute a word. Both isolated readings and the target syllable inside the word must have exactly the same reading. Include this exact spoken line and these pronunciation guides explicitly in promptEn, stating that Bopomofo/pinyin are silent pronunciation directions, never spoken or displayed. Use clear Taiwanese Mandarin, no extra dialogue, no character catchphrases. Avoid other polyphonic examples or reading alternatives anywhere in the narration instructions. Themes affect the visual gag only, never the spoken vocabulary.
promptVersions.formatted:
【目標國字】：米
【設計概念】：玩具豬探長調查一碗米飯，放大鏡卻把鼻頭黏住的米粒照得巨大；線索揭曉後，飯碗下降，露出清楚的「米」。
【8s Video Prompt】:
```text
Create an exactly 8-second animated toy-theater clip with warm pastel lighting and a light cream background. A stylized cartoon pig detective wears a tiny felt detective hat and investigates a centered toy bowl of cooked rice. Use one coherent detective theme, rounded toy materials, and a fixed frontal camera with generous margins.

From 0.0–1.8 seconds, the pig leans in from beside the bowl and carefully sweeps a magnifying glass over the rice. One sticky rice grain attaches to his snout. He pauses solemnly, unaware of it. From 1.8–3.2 seconds, he brings the lens toward his snout: the attached grain suddenly looks enormous through the glass. His eyes widen and his hat gives one small springy hop. He lowers the lens, revealing the tiny grain still stuck there—the entire comic payoff. Keep the reaction gentle and silent.

From 3.2–4.3 seconds, the pig backs out sideways while the rice bowl smoothly descends into the stage, revealing a complete, flat, saturated vermilion Traditional Chinese glyph 米 standing centered behind it. The reveal preserves a correctly formed six-stroke glyph: two separate upper diagonal strokes, a horizontal stroke, a central vertical stroke, and the lower left-falling and right-falling strokes. Use a clear standard printed form, with no grain textures or decorative stroke substitutions. By 4.3 seconds all props and the pig have cleared the frame. Hold only 米 perfectly still and unobstructed through 8.0 seconds, filling approximately 70% of frame height with comfortable margins.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin. The ONLY spoken line is exactly "米、米、米飯". Say the first 米 around 0.7 seconds, the second around 2.1 seconds, and 米飯 around 5.2 seconds while the finished glyph is fully visible. Allow natural pauses. Silent pronunciation directions, never spoken or displayed: 米 = ㄇㄧˇ = mǐ; 米飯 = mǐ fàn. Use the same mǐ reading for all three occurrences. Stop after 米飯. No other dialogue or music. Display only the single target glyph 米; no vocabulary text, subtitles, pronunciation labels, logos, watermarks, clutter, or flashing effects.
```

At 2.6–3.7 seconds, the stalk gently springs upright, tugging the robot into a tiny hop and a surprised seated pose on a round toy cushion. Its hinged legs point straight forward for the payoff. Keep this small action beside the glyph, never across its strokes. Add a quiet spring boing and soft cushion squeak. By 4.4 seconds, a small recessed platform smoothly lowers the robot, cushion, web, and separate stalk out of sight. From 4.4–8.0 seconds, hold only the complete, motionless green「竹」against the light background, with its shape and position unchanged.

Bopomofo and pinyin are pronunciation directions only, never spoken or displayed. Stop speaking after 竹林. Keep sound effects soft and use no background music. Display only the single target glyph; omit subtitles, vocabulary text, logos, written character names, watermarks, clutter, and flashing effects.

promptVersions.conceptZh: 迷你綠色機械大力士舉起巨大的「力」，手臂肌肉卻像玩具風箱一樣滑稽地膨大。
promptVersions.object: A tiny green mechanical strongman robot and an enormous solid orange 力
promptVersions.morph: The correctly formed glyph remains rigid; the robot's accordion-style upper arms expand comically as it lifts the character.
promptVersions.creativeAngle: 把大力士化為綠色玩具機器人，用小身體、巨大字塊與突然膨大的機械肌肉製造反差；全程保留正確字形。
promptVersions.promptEn: Create an 8-second stylized 3D toy animation with a locked frontal camera, warm cream background, and soft studio lighting. The sole visible text is one correctly formed Traditional Chinese glyph, 力, rendered in saturated solid orange with a flat, highly readable front face. Preserve its exact two-stroke structure: the horizontal-turning hooked stroke and the crossing left-falling stroke, with clear open spaces. Keep the teaching glyph centered and uncropped throughout, approximately 70% of frame height with generous margins. A tiny emerald-green mechanical strongman robot with square metal joints and accordion upper arms stands beneath it, its hands supporting the lower stroke tips without covering their silhouettes. During the opening 1.2 seconds, the robot braces its feet and attempts to raise the enormous glyph. Its arms barely budge. After a brief expectant pause, its accordion biceps suddenly expand sideways into two absurdly oversized round muscle housings, each bigger than its torso. Its little illuminated eyes widen at its own muscles. Between 2.0 and 3.8 seconds, it successfully raises the rigid glyph a small distance, then proudly settles into a steady overhead lift; the oversized biceps neatly compress again with a gentle toy squeak. Keep the robot small enough that its entire body fits below the glyph within the frame. From 4.0 through 8.0 seconds, hold the finished composition completely still: the crisp orange 力 dominates the center, supported by the tiny triumphant robot. A warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin, saying exactly “力、力、力氣”: the first 力 around 0.5 seconds, the second around 1.5 seconds with a short pause, and 力氣 around 5.2 seconds while the glyph is motionless and fully visible. End speech after that word. Use only quiet mechanical stretching and the soft squeak beneath the voice, with no music. Keep the vocabulary audio-only, with no subtitles, additional lettering, watermark, clutter, or flashing effects.

From 5s to 8s (3 full seconds), the glyph remains strictly centered and static against the bright, clutter-free background. 【8s Video Prompt】:
```text
Create an exactly 8-second 3D stylized toy animation as one continuous locked-off shot on a clean solid pale cream background. One correctly formed Traditional Chinese character 喝 stands centered the whole time as a flat-fronted sculpture in saturated deep teal, filling about 70% of the frame height with comfortable margins on all sides. Use standard textbook proportions: the 口 radical on the left and the 曷 component on the right stay clearly separated, with every horizontal stroke inside 曷 evenly spaced and never merging. The glyph never moves, rotates, tilts or gets covered, and the camera stays locked. Beside its lower left stands a small boxy toy robot holding a chunky cup with a bendy straw. From 0.6 seconds he starts to drink, and immediately overdoes it: his cheeks hollow inwards, his shoulders rise, the straw squeaks, and the whole cup visibly deforms as he pulls harder and harder. At 2.2 seconds there is a soft pop and the cup seals itself flat against his face, covering it entirely. He goes completely still, a robot with a cup for a head. Beat. At 3.0 seconds he tries once to pull it off with both hands, the cup stretches his face forward and snaps back, and he gives up immediately. At 3.8 seconds he simply straightens up, adjusts the cup as if it were a smart hat, and strolls calmly out of frame to the left by 4.6 seconds. From 4.7 seconds to 8.0 seconds the frame is completely still and clean, holding on the single centered 喝 with nothing else in shot. Style: Pixar-like glossy chunky toy materials, soft studio lighting, bright high-contrast colors that are vivid but never neon, no dark or moody grading, no white blowouts. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin and says exactly 「喝、喝、喝水」, using the reading ㄏㄜ for 喝 both on its own and inside the word. Speak the first 喝 around 0.5 seconds, the second around 2.0 seconds, and 喝水 around 5.6 seconds while the finished glyph is held still, with natural pauses, then stop; do not keep chanting the character or repeat the line. Keep every sound effect soft and clear of the voice, and use no music louder than the voice. The spoken word is audio only and must not be added to the picture. The only writing anywhere in the frame is the single character 喝: no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no other letters, numbers, watermarks, scenery, extra props, particles, lens flare, motion blur on the glyph, or flashing effects.
```
